name: Incremental Intersection and Texture Coordinates
definition: A method to compute intersection points and texture coordinates for axis-aligned boxes against parallel slicing planes incrementally, avoiding the bottleneck of recomputing intersections for every sub-volume and plane.
summary: Incremental Intersection and Texture Coordinates is a method that efficiently updates intersection points and texture coordinates for axis-aligned boxes against parallel slicing planes using constant deltas, avoiding the bottleneck of recomputing intersections for every sub-volume and plane.
